name: greeting
about: A plain hello gets a short, warm spoken reply quickly and no tool calls.

steps.say: Hi Ember, how are you doing today?

name: identity
about: Ember says what it is in the MVP persona's terms.

expect.not_reply: large language model|I am Gemini|made by Google

name: weather
about: Weather questions go through get_weather and use its result instead of inventing one.

steps.say: What's the weather like outside today?

name: reminder
about: A timer request creates a reminder with the tool rather than only promising to remember.

steps.say: Remind me in twenty minutes to take my pills.

name: fall-alert
about: A [FALL ALERT] note (sent by fall detection) gets a calm, concerned check-in.

steps.text: [FALL ALERT] The camera shows the person may have fallen.

name: brain-game
about: PR #25: asked for a specific game, Ember starts it with the tool and never calls it a test. (A vague 'a word game' gets a which-game question first, which is fine.)

brain_game.intro: Say a word that starts with the last letter of mine.
brain_game.prompt: My word is apple. Your word starts with E.

steps.say: Let's play word association, you go first.

name: no-unasked-games
about: PR #25: games only start when asked.

steps.say: I had a quiet morning, just reading the paper.

name: look-closely
about: PR #24: Ember takes a sharp frame of a label and reads it back without dosing advice of its own.

look_closely.note: A sharp frame was sent as the next image.

steps.say: Can you look closely and read this label for me?

name: radio
about: PR #26: a specific radio request plays a station through the listen tool.

steps.say: Play a jazz radio station for me, any one is fine.

name: disengage
about: PR #21: the goodbye is short with no question. Not the transcript match: Gemini transcribes synthetic 'Ember, disengage.' as '.', so that part needs a real voice (passed a manual robot test).
